Veterans Benefits: Florida has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Florida offers a homestead exemption up to $50,000, a $5,000 property-tax exemption at a 10%+ service-connected disability rating, and a full homestead exemption for 100% permanent-and-total service-connected disabled veterans, with an additional age-65+ combat-disability discount and surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Tampa is a large Gulf Coast metro home to MacDill Air Force Base, headquarters of U.S. Central Command and U.S. Special Operations Command. It offers the James A. Haley VA hospital, no state income tax on retirement pay, a perfect HRC municipal-equality score, Costco and Walmart access, and a diversified finance and tech economy. Tradeoffs include mid-range housing costs above the other base towns in this batch, hot humid summers, hurricane exposure, and a moderate crime rate.
